description: This file defines an abstract interface class `AudioSource` in the `cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming` namespace, which provides a method to retrieve audio data from an audio source (likely for streaming or processing purposes). It declares a pure virtual method `GetMoreAudioData` for subclasses to implement.

classes.name: AudioSource
classes.description: An interface representing a source of audio data, providing a method to retrieve more audio data. Implementers are expected to provide the logic for fetching the audio stream.

methods.name: GetMoreAudioData
methods.description: Retrieves additional audio data into the provided buffer. Returns the number of bytes read or a negative value if an error occurs. Handles muting state via the `muted` reference.
